programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Composición Musical para Cine, Televisión y Videojuegos
institution: Berklee College of Music, Valencia Campus (Berklee Valencia) — degree awarded under affiliation with Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV)
institution_type: private specialist school (Centro Superior Autorizado de Enseñanzas Artísticas de la Música) awarding an OFFICIAL UPV-affiliated título universitario
city: Valencia — Berklee College of Music, Valencia Campus, Palau de les Arts Reina Sofía–Anexo Sur, Avenida Profesor Lopez Piñero 1, 46013 Valencia
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — and the programme states its own RUCT code, which is the strongest form of evidence the shared brief asks for. Verbatim from the programme page: 'The Master of Music in scoring for film, television, and video games is additionally accredited by Spanish educational authorities (CÓDIGO RUCT DEL TÍTULO: 4313419). Berklee College of Music's Valencia campus (Berklee Valencia), the authorized center of higher education in arts, imparts this program under affiliation with Universidad Politécnica de Valencia (UPV) and it is valid throughout the European Higher Education Area (EHEA).' And on the centre: 'Berklee Valencia is a Centro Superior Autorizado de Enseñanzas Artísticas de la Música, Código del centro: 46061691 (Authorized Higher Education Center for Artistic Music Education) in the European Higher Education Area, officially recognized as such by Resolution of the General Director of Universities, Higher Studies and Sciences no. 6844, dated August 8, 2012. [DOCV no. 6844, 08.21.2012, SPAIN].' RUCT 4313419 CONFIRMS IT INDEPENDENTLY. Estado: 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)'. Nivel académico: Máster - RD 1393/2007 (1); Nivel MECES 3; Rama: Artes y Humanidades; Campo: 'Industrias Culturales: diseño, animación, cinematografía y producción audiovisual'. Fecha de verificación 19/09/2012; BOE 15/11/2013, 22/07/2014, 23/04/2019; accreditation renewals 24/05/2021 and 10/05/2017. Wave-1 additionally recorded a 'Modificación no sustancial' dated 12/09/2024, i.e. the title was still being actively maintained two years before access date. ⭐ NOTE THE STRUCTURE CAREFULLY: this is a DUAL award. It is (a) a US Master of Music accredited by NECHE — verbatim, 'All graduate programs at Berklee are accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education ... which is internationally recognized as an authority on educational quality' — AND (b) a Spanish official máster universitario registered to UPV. It is NOT a título propio, and it is NOT a Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas outside RUCT: it is in RUCT, under a public university. ⚠️ ONE UNRESOLVED FLAG CARRIED FORWARD FROM WAVE 1: this title is absent from UPV's own 2026-27 master catalogue feed. That is consistent with the teaching centre being Berklee rather than a UPV school, but it means the UPV-side listing could not be cross-checked. See conflicts.
ects_breakdown: RUCT: 48 obligatorios + 6 optativos + 0 prácticas + 6 TFM = 60. ⚠️ CONTRAST WITH THE BERKLEE-SIDE DESCRIPTION: Berklee describes the same programme as 'three semesters of study—or one full academic year: fall, spring, and summer semesters' and prices it per credit at USD 1,615 on a US credit system, not on ECTS. The two credit systems sit side by side; the 60-ECTS figure is the Spanish registered structure. Berklee's own 'culminating experience' corresponds to the 6-ECTS TFM.
modality: presencial (fully on-campus, Valencia). Verbatim: 'All graduate programs on the Valencia campus are designed to be completed in three semesters of study—or one full academic year: fall, spring, and summer semesters.' Programme start: September 2026 for the 2026/2027 academic year.
language_of_instruction: ⭐ ENGLISH — 100%, and stated flatly
language_of_instruction_verbatim: Programme page, 'Program Information' block, verbatim: 'Language — English (all classes are taught in English)'. This is an explicit primary-source statement on the programme's own page, not an inference from an English-language website. ⚠️ CAVEAT ON PROVENANCE: unlike the UPV masters, this statement is on Berklee's site rather than on a Spanish-language UPV plan de estudios page; UPV publishes no catalogue entry for this title (see conflicts), so no Spanish-language 'idioma de impartición' field could be cross-checked. The statement is nonetheless unambiguous and comes from the institution that teaches the programme.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND as a numeric level on the pages fetched — Berklee's How to Apply and Entrance Requirements pages do not state a TOEFL/IELTS threshold for this programme, though they require the statement of purpose ('must be in English, between 400 and 500 words'), the résumé ('in English') and the letter of recommendation ('must be written in English and signed by your recommender') all to be in English, and the admissions process includes interviews. A specific English test requirement may exist elsewhere on the Berklee site; it was NOT located and is therefore recorded as NOT FOUND rather than assumed. CANDIDATE FIT: English fluent — no obstacle. NO SPANISH IS REQUIRED for admission or teaching.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026/2027 Academic Year — stamped as such by Berklee, and explicitly 'the direct costs charged by the college for the graduate programs starting in September 2026'. 2027-28 rates NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — and the reason matters. This programme is NOT priced off the Valencian public-fee decree at all: Berklee charges a single flat US-dollar tuition to every student regardless of nationality or residence. There is NO 'Estudiantado tipo 1 / tipo 2' split of the kind every UPV-taught master publishes, and DECRETO 101/2024's doubling rule for non-resident non-EU students does not reach it. So the correct reading is: no non-EU surcharge exists, because there is no discounted domestic rate to be surcharged FROM. The flat price is already far above what a non-EU student pays for any public Spanish master in this batch. Recorded as NO (with reason), not as NOT FOUND, because the fee table is complete, itemised, and applies uniformly — Berklee lists no nationality- or residence-based variation anywhere in it.
additional_fees_detail: ALL FIGURES ARE US DOLLARS, verbatim from the 2026/2027 table: 'Application Fee (Waived for Berklee alumni) $150'; 'Nonrefundable Tuition Deposit (To be credited towards first tuition payment) $2,500'; 'Tuition $50,430'; 'Comprehensive Fee (Charged entering the fall semester to all students for the cost of non-curricular facilities, programs, and services) $1,600'; 'Student Health Insurance Plan — Students must accept enrollment in Berklee's Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) or submit a waiver request indicating comparable coverage'; 'PROFESSIONAL RECORDING SERVICES FEE — For Master of Music in Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games ONLY — $2,990'; 'Required Software Bundle — Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games — $700'. The recording fee is explained verbatim: 'this mandatory fee is billed to all scoring for film, television, and video games graduate students. The fee contributes to a fraction of the extraordinary studio and recording expenses unique to the scoring program. This includes: on-campus recording sessions with professional session musicians; remote recording sessions with professional orchestras; and an off-site recording session at a world-class studio.' The software bundle is NOT optional: 'Students cannot opt out of, or receive any exemption for, purchasing their program's software bundle.' INDIRECT COSTS BERKLEE ITSELF ESTIMATES: 'Laptop (May be waived) $3,000; Housing $10,000–$12,000; Books $300–$800; Local transportation $300–$600; Personal expenses $1,000.' PENALTY FEES: '$250 late payment fee'; '$250 late check-in fee'; 'thesis continuation fee of $400' if the culminating experience is not submitted by the first day of classes of the following semester. The comprehensive fee explicitly covers 'students' required registration into the Spanish educational system' and 'students' compulsory health insurance' — i.e. the Spanish-side administrative cost is bundled, not extra.
entry_requirements: Verbatim: 'Applicants are required to hold a bachelor's degree in music composition, electronic music production, or film scoring. Outstanding musicians with bachelor's degrees in performance or OTHER DISCIPLINES, WHO HAVE A STRONG BACKGROUND IN SONGWRITING OR COMPOSITION, will also be considered.' PROFILE SOUGHT, verbatim: 'We seek focused, motivated, innovative, and, above all, passionately creative candidates with excellent academic and/or professional backgrounds. Additional study and/or work experience in the following areas will be helpful but is not required: interactive scoring techniques, conducting to picture, basic music editing skills, and project collaboration. Prospective students do not need to have extensive direct experience working with live orchestras.' Ideal candidates 'Demonstrate a strong compositional foundation from their studies and/or professional experience; POSSESS THE ABILITY TO NOTATE ONE'S IDEAS COMPETENTLY, FOLLOW AN ORCHESTRAL SCORE, AND CONCEIVE MATERIAL IN AN ORCHESTRAL CONTEXT; and Exhibit passion for musical storytelling and a demonstrated aptitude for visual music.' APPLICATION PACKAGE, verbatim: online application plus '$150 non-refundable application fee'; 'statement of purpose ... (must be in English, between 400 and 500 words)'; 'Résumé/curriculum vitae ... in English'; 'One letter of recommendation ... should come from a professional with whom you have worked or collaborated and who can convey your musical strengths and skills. Recommendations should not be done by friends or peers'; 'program-specific portfolio'; official transcripts. ⚠️ CREDENTIAL EVALUATION IS MANDATORY AND SLOW FOR A TUNISIAN DEGREE, verbatim: 'Transcripts from institutions outside the US or Canada must be evaluated by an approved third-party credential evaluation service. Berklee works closely with SpanTran and Educational Credential Evaluators, and we recommend their services. Please ask for a COURSE-BY-COURSE evaluation. The credential evaluation process CAN TAKE SEVERAL WEEKS to complete, and we strongly urge you to begin the process as early as possible. Your application will not be complete until we have received credential evaluation reports for all of your academic credentials.' And: 'We do not accept international transcripts directly from the applicant and will not accept a translation to complete an application.' Up to 40 places on this programme per the Entrance Requirements page (the programme page says 30 — see conflicts).
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT BUT CONDITIONAL — and the condition is musical, not academic. The rule names 'bachelor's degrees in performance or other disciplines' as considerable, but ONLY for 'Outstanding musicians ... who have a strong background in songwriting or composition'. A Software Engineering degree is squarely an 'other discipline', so the degree itself is not a bar; the bar is the portfolio and the demonstrated compositional foundation. ⚠️ THE REAL GATE FOR THIS CANDIDATE IS NOTATION AND ORCHESTRAL LITERACY: 'Possess the ability to notate one's ideas competently, follow an orchestral score, and conceive material in an orchestral context.' A working music producer/DJ may or may not meet that; DAW-based production alone does not. This is exactly the 'what is the prueba de acceso, and can a producer's portfolio satisfy it?' question the shared brief tells us to ask, and here the published answer is: score literacy is expected, live-orchestra experience is not ('Prospective students do not need to have extensive direct experience working with live orchestras'). RECORDED AS: explicit acceptance of non-music degrees, conditional on a compositional portfolio — quoted, not inferred.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — RUCT 4313419 omits the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row entirely (null in output/ruct-detail.jsonl), which is NOT the same as 0. AT APPLICANT LEVEL Berklee publishes NO complementos formativos mechanism at all — as a US-style graduate programme it screens on portfolio at admission instead of bridging afterwards. There is no published route by which an admitted student takes extra preparatory credits. Effectively: you either satisfy the compositional entrance bar or you are not admitted. I am quoting Berklee's Entrance Requirements page for that, and recording RUCT's row as ABSENT.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND — no credit-recognition, transfer or advanced-standing scheme is published for this programme, and none of the Valencian public-fee recognition provisions apply because the programme is not priced off the decree. The Spanish-side 300-ECTS question is therefore irrelevant here in the usual sense: entry turns on a bachelor's degree plus portfolio, and the 300-ECTS length confers no advantage. WHAT DOES MATTER FOR A 5-YEAR FOREIGN DEGREE IS THE CREDENTIAL EVALUATION, verbatim: 'Credential evaluation is a process that provides Berklee with an official report that lists the courses taken, marks received, and honors earned by an applicant in their US equivalents. For example, the report will tell us if an applicant has the equivalent of a bachelor's degree, or other academic honor(s), and will list the marks received in the standard 4.0 US grading system.' A 300-ECTS 5-year Tunisian degree should evaluate at or above US bachelor's level, which is what is required — but it must be evidenced through SpanTran or ECE at the applicant's own cost, and cannot be self-submitted.
application_window_2027: ⭐ THE ONLY PROGRAMME IN THE BATCH WITH A PUBLISHED, YEAR-INDEPENDENT DEADLINE STRUCTURE — Berklee publishes month-and-day deadlines that recur annually rather than a dated 2026-27 calendar, so these are directly usable for a September 2027 intake, although the page does not itself name 2027. Verbatim: 'To be considered for admission by our Graduate Board of Admissions, we must receive your completed application and all supporting documents by 11:59 p.m. EST on the deadline. Apply to Berklee Valencia in any of the following cycles, but consider Early Action to get a head start and take advantage of an earlier decision date along with more time for visa preparation and exclusive online opportunities to connect with your future cohort.' 'EARLY ACTION — Application deadline: November 1. Scholarship deadline: November 15. Admissions decisions issued by December 15.' 'REGULAR ACTION — Application deadline: January 15. Scholarship deadline: February 1. Admissions decisions issued by March 15.' 'EXTENDED ACTION — Application deadline: March 10. Scholarship deadline: March 10. Admissions decisions issued by April 20.' 'Note: Scholarship application deadlines are different from the Program Application deadlines for Early and Regular action.' FOR A SEPTEMBER 2027 START that implies Early Action closing 1 November 2026 with a decision by 15 December 2026 — but note the page carries no year, so treat the mapping to 2026/2027 dates as the natural reading of an annually recurring cycle rather than as a dated publication.
application_rounds: Early Action — application 1 November; scholarship 15 November; decisions by 15 December
Regular Action — application 15 January; scholarship 1 February; decisions by 15 March
Extended Action — application 10 March; scholarship 10 March; decisions by 20 April
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES, AND BERKLEE SAYS SO IN THESE WORDS: 'consider Early Action to get a head start and take advantage of an earlier decision date along with MORE TIME FOR VISA PREPARATION and exclusive online opportunities to connect with your future cohort.' Two further reasons specific to a Tunisian applicant: the mandatory third-party credential evaluation 'can take several weeks to complete', and the Early Action scholarship deadline (15 November) is the earliest of the three — which matters because Berklee Valencia allocates substantial scholarship money (see scholarships_internal).
admissions_contact_email: admissionsvalencia@berklee.edu — Office of Admissions, Berklee Valencia. Phone +34 963 332 802, hours 09:00–17:00 Monday to Friday. Postal: Office of Admissions, Palau de les Arts Reina Sofía - Anexo Sur, Avenida Profesor Lopez Piñero 1, 46013 Valencia, Spain. Programme Director: Lucio M. Godoy.
curriculum_summary: Verbatim: 'This one-year intensive Master of Music degree focuses on the art and craft of composing, orchestrating, editing, and producing music for the screen using the latest technology. Students lead recording sessions with professional session musicians and receive in-depth instruction in narrative analysis, orchestration, and the use of dramatic effects to support the story.' Headline elements: 'Creation of your own sound libraries; Live recording sessions with professional musicians; Live remote recording sessions with the Budapest Art Orchestra; LIVE RECORDING OF YOUR FINAL PROJECT IN LONDON WITH A FULL ORCHESTRA'. RECORDING PRACTICE, verbatim: 'Several times throughout the year, students record their compositions on our scoring stage with professional session musicians from the main orchestras in Valencia. Students also participate in remote recording sessions with orchestras such as the Budapest Art orchestra... The final project of the year includes a recording session at a major studio. In the past, students have recorded at AIR STUDIOS AND ABBEY ROAD STUDIOS in London.' TECHNOLOGY, verbatim: 'each station contains an Apple Desktop Computer, DAW Controller, Midi Keyboard, Sound Card, and Video Monitor(s). Up-to-date software is installed at each station, including PRO TOOLS, DIGITAL PERFORMER, LOGIC, CUBASE, VIENNA ENSEMBLE PRO, DORICO, FINALE, AND SIBELIUS (with Note Performer), each with a wide range of sample libraries and plugins available.' WORKING METHOD, verbatim: 'Projects are assigned in the same way that composers are hired in any real-world situation — including quick turnarounds, demanding producers, and the necessity to compose in a wide range of styles and genres to meet meticulous requirements. The recording sessions, both live and remote, provide students with ample experience in writing for different orchestra sizes, including a full 50-piece orchestra.' ⚠️ WHAT THIS IS NOT: it is a COMPOSITION and SCORING craft programme, not sound-and-music COMPUTING. There is no DSP, no machine learning, no music information retrieval and no software engineering content anywhere in the published description. For a candidate whose asset is engineering plus production, the fit is with the production/technology side of the industry (path P) and with screen-music craft (path A), not with the audio-AI research paths.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Programme Director: Lucio M. Godoy (film composer). Academic Committee of the Degree, verbatim: 'Simone Pilon, Executive Director, Berklee Valencia; Lucio Godoy, Program Director of Master of Music in Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games; RAÚL TEROL BOLINCHES, UNIVERSIDAD POLITÉCNICA DE VALENCIA; Alfons Conde, Associate Professor; Martina Naretto, Senior Coordinator for Academic Assessment, Records, and Registrar Services' — note the named UPV representative on the committee, which is the visible mechanism of the UPV affiliation. Culminating Experience Jury: Alfons Conde, Lucio Godoy, Vicente Ortiz Gimeno, plus an 'External Jury (chosen by the student)'. Facilities include a scoring stage, tech labs and studios on the Palau de les Arts campus.
industry_links: ⭐ THE STRONGEST INDUSTRY LINKAGE IN THE BATCH, and it is built into the curriculum rather than bolted on: professional session musicians from Valencia's main orchestras recording on the campus scoring stage; remote sessions with the Budapest Art Orchestra; and a final-project recording at a major London studio, with Air Studios and Abbey Road named as past venues. The programme also runs a 'Visiting Artists' strand and a 'Careers' section. The $2,990 Professional Recording Services Fee is the mechanism that funds this — i.e. the industry access is real and separately billed.
thesis_or_internship: Culminating Experience (= the 6-ECTS TFM in the Spanish structure), verbatim: 'Scoring for film, television, and video games students are required to complete a culminating experience that serves as both a practicum and a bridge to the professional world. The tangible end product of this experience will take the form of an ORIGINAL SCORE, SCHOLARLY PAPER AND/OR RESEARCH PROJECT, or other enterprise that offers an original solution to the challenge of marrying music to visual media... A culminating experience committee evaluates the final project.' TIMELINE, verbatim: 'Semester One: Students propose their culminating experience to their advisor and program director. Semester Two: Students revise and refine their proposal and get final approval from their advisor. Semester Three: Students complete and present their final project to the culminating experience committee.' The 2025 cycle ran 'June 5–9: Rehearsal presentations and definitive committee selection; June 19: CE documents submission (outcome and reflective); July 1 and 2 of 2025 final presentation'. ⭐ NOTE THE RESEARCH OPTION: the CE may be 'a scholarly paper and/or research project', which is the doctoral-preparation route inside an otherwise craft-focused degree. No internship is published.

scholarships_internal.name: Berklee Valencia graduate scholarships
scholarships_internal.note: ⭐ SCHOLARSHIPS ARE ON A SEPARATE, EARLIER CLOCK THAN ADMISSION AND THAT IS THE KEY OPERATIONAL FACT, verbatim: 'Note: Scholarship application deadlines are different from the Program Application deadlines for Early and Regular action.' The three scholarship deadlines are 15 November (Early Action), 1 February (Regular Action) and 10 March (Extended Action). SCALE: a search result from Berklee Valencia's own news feed referenced 'more than €125,000 in scholarships allocated for students admitted to the campus master's degree programs for the 2026–2027 academic year' — ⚠️ that figure comes from a SEARCH INDEX SNIPPET, not from a page I fetched, and is recorded as unverified. Berklee Valencia also runs a separate 'Valencian Students Scholarships Program', which by its name is for local students and would not apply. Amounts, criteria and non-EU eligibility for the general graduate scholarships: NOT FOUND on the pages fetched. Given tuition of $50,430, scholarship scale is decisive for this programme and must be established directly with admissionsvalencia@berklee.edu.

conflicts.detail: The programme page states 'Number of Places Available — 30 seats — Up to 30 students can take part in the Master of Music in Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games program each year', while the Entrance Requirements page states 'Up to 40 students can take part in the Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games program each year'. Both on valencia.berklee.edu at access date 2026-08-25. Not resolved.

Wave 1 flagged that this RUCT-registered UPV title does NOT appear in UPV's own 2026-27 master catalogue feed. That was re-encountered in this pass: the title has no www.upv.es/estudios/master/ microsite of the kind every UPV-taught master has, and all programme information lives on valencia.berklee.edu. The likely explanation is benign — the teaching centre is Berklee Valencia (centro 46061691), not a UPV school, so UPV lists it among its titles but not in the microsite catalogue — but it could NOT be confirmed from a UPV page. Consequence: no Spanish-language UPV 'idioma de impartición' or 'precio' field exists to cross-check Berklee's statements against. Flagged for a human.

Every fee for this programme is published in US DOLLARS on Berklee's site, while the schema field is tuition_total_eur. No EUR figure is published and no exchange rate has been applied here — inventing one would be a fabricated fee. tuition_total_eur is set to 0 as a null marker and the real figures are carried in tuition_total_usd (55720 = $50,430 tuition + $1,600 comprehensive + $2,990 recording services + $700 software) and tuition_per_credit_usd (1615). Downstream consumers MUST convert explicitly and date the rate.

notes: COST ARITHMETIC, SHOWN, IN USD: tuition $50,430 + comprehensive fee $1,600 + professional recording services fee $2,990 + required software bundle $700 = $55,720 in mandatory direct costs, plus a $150 application fee and a $2,500 deposit that is credited against tuition. Berklee's own estimated indirect costs add $10,000–$12,000 housing, up to $3,000 laptop, $300–$800 books, $300–$600 transport and $1,000 personal — an all-in year comfortably above $70,000. Per-credit rate $1,615. ⭐ THIS IS BY A LARGE MARGIN THE MOST EXPENSIVE PROGRAMME IN THE BATCH — roughly ten times the non-EU cost of the UPV public masters (4,240.80 EUR) and about three times the UC3M Telecom+Big Data double (17,312.40 EUR), which was itself the most expensive public option found. Funding availability is a primary ranking factor for this candidate, and at this price the programme is only viable with a substantial scholarship, whose scale is NOT PUBLISHED. ⭐ WHAT IT UNIQUELY OFFERS: it is the only programme in this batch that is simultaneously (a) an official Spanish máster universitario in RUCT with PhD access, (b) taught 100% in English with no Spanish requirement whatsoever, and (c) squarely in the music industry. For a candidate blocked out of the Spanish-taught public masters by language, this is the one route in this batch that language does not close. ⚠️ THE GATE IS THE PORTFOLIO, NOT THE DEGREE: 'the ability to notate one's ideas competently, follow an orchestral score, and conceive material in an orchestral context'. That is a score-literacy bar a DAW-based producer may not clear. It is the decisive question to answer before spending the $150 application fee and the SpanTran/ECE credential-evaluation cost. ⚠️ SEE ALSO the sibling record at input line 4: UPV/Berklee's OTHER official music master, 'Innovación en Tecnología Musical' (RUCT 4314875), which was the Spanish official twin of Berklee's Music Production, Technology and Innovation programme, is EXTINGUIDA POR NO RENOVACIÓN. So of the Berklee Valencia music masters, this Scoring title is the one that still carries a live Spanish official qualification.

Verbatim learning outcomes: '1. Manejo de Python y R: el conocimiento en programación de estos dos lenguajes, los más utilizados en ciencia de datos... 2. Uso de herramientas y librerías específicas: entre ellas, Pandas y NumPy, para la manipulación y análisis de datos... También trabajaremos con programas pensados para la minería de datos. 3. Aplicación de técnicas de análisis avanzado con inteligencia artificial: comprende los fundamentos de machine learning y deep learning, incluyendo el desarrollo y evaluación de algoritmos supervisados y no supervisados. 4. Gestión y almacenamiento de big data y almacenamiento: entiende cómo procesar y analizar grandes volúmenes de datos hasta su almacenamiento en la nube (cloud computing). 5. Crea visualizaciones de datos efectivas... 6. Céntrate en la seguridad y privacidad de datos.' Method, verbatim: 'Trabajarás de manera práctica en LABORATORIOS VIRTUALES, donde analizarás casos reales de big data aplicados a la detección de patrones, optimización de procesos, mejora de la toma de decisiones y análisis predictivo'; also 'aplicaciones no code y low code para el manejo de datos'. ⭐ VENDOR CERTIFICATION IS A HEADLINE FEATURE AND IS THE PROGRAMME'S REAL DIFFERENTIATOR, verbatim: 'Este Máster incluye módulos formativos para adquirir los conocimientos indispensables para obtener las siguientes certificaciones de Microsoft: Certificación AI-900: Azure AI Fundamentals; Certificación DP-900: Azure Data Fundamentals. UPF's own tariff page (www.upf.edu/web/masters/preus) states that for students from outside the EU the Consell Social approves the credit price annually and that for 2025-2026 it is 93,5 EUR per credit, versus the decree's 19,37 EUR/credit for EU/resident students in a non-habilitante master — a multiplier of roughly 4.8x. 93,50 x 60 = 5,610 EUR for the 60-ECTS master alone.

non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit, quantified, and published on the programme page itself: "Standard enrollment: €2,736" versus "Non-EU residents: €5,079" for the same 60-ECTS master, i.e. a surcharge of €2,343 (1.86x). Mechanism, from UAM's own tasas page: students from non-EU countries without official residency in Spain pay at the "tercera matrícula" (third-enrolment) rate, or the "cuarta" rate for másteres habilitantes, as established in the Comunidad de Madrid public-prices decree (Decreto 43/2022, BOCM 01/07/2022). This is a repricing to a penalty tier, not a flat uplift. Note it is charged on non-RESIDENCE, so the candidate cannot avoid it by relocating.
entry_requirements: An engineering degree or a bachelor's in ICT-related fields, with a MINIMUM PRIOR COURSEWORK PROFILE: 24 ECTS in mathematics (calculus, linear algebra, probability/statistics), 12 ECTS programming, 6 ECTS signal processing, and 6 ECTS machine learning. Admitted backgrounds: engineering degrees in ICT areas; equivalent EHEA degrees; degrees from outside Europe with equivalency demonstrated. 30 places. Admission application costs 27,54 EUR. Applicants with a non-Spanish access degree must supply the Ministry's «certificación de equivalencia de nota media para estudios en el extranjero».
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT — "engineering degrees in ICT areas" and non-European degrees with demonstrated equivalency are both named. THE REAL GATE IS THE SUBJECT PROFILE, NOT THE DEGREE TITLE: the candidate must be able to show 24 ECTS maths + 12 programming + 6 signal processing + 6 machine learning in his transcript. A 300-ECTS 5-year Software Engineering degree will almost certainly clear maths and programming; the 6 ECTS of SIGNAL PROCESSING and 6 of MACHINE LEARNING are the lines to check against his actual transcript before applying.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level — the register publishes Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0 for 4317140 (60 ECTS = 48 obligatorios + 12 TFM, 0 optativos, 0 prácticas). At APPLICANT level the programme offers an OPTIONAL levelling module in signal processing worth 1 ECTS for students whose prior training in that area falls below 12 ECTS — small, optional, and cheap. Separately, UAM's institution-wide rules state that the Comisión Académica of each master «determinará si debe cursar complementos de formación» at admission, so a formal power to impose them exists university-wide; for this title the published expectation is the 1-ECTS levelling module only.
credit_recognition_available: YES — A REAL, INSTITUTION-WIDE MECHANISM, and the best-documented one in this batch. UAM's official 2026-27 admission process document states that the Comisión Académica «determinará si debe cursar complementos de formación y si existe posibilidad de solicitar reconocimiento de créditos por los estudios previos realizados», and that «Se podrá señalar el número de créditos de los que el estudiante pueda solicitar reconocimiento (si tiene formación previa reconocible). Posteriormente a su matrícula el estudiante solicitará formalmente el reconocimiento en la Administración del Centro ... pero esta indicación le servirá para saber de cuántos créditos debe matricularse y cuantos no serán necesarios, porque puedan reconocerse.» So recognition is assessed AT ADMISSION and reduces the credits actually enrolled and paid for. IMPORTANT COUNTERWEIGHT from the same document: «La titulación de acceso al Máster que se considerará es siempre la de grado o equivalente. Cualquier otra titulación académica que posea el solicitante podrá incorporarse a la solicitud de forma complementaria y, en su caso, ser valorada por la coordinación del Máster como otros méritos» — extra qualifications count as merit, not as automatic advanced standing. Whether a 300-ECTS single degree yields recognised credits is a coordinator's decision. No figure is promised.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for the September 2027 (curso 2027-28) intake. For curso 2026-2027 UAM published, verbatim: PRIMERO «De 4 de febrero a 8 de abril de 2026 (Para todos los estudiantes, aunque no hayan finalizado estudios de acceso)»; SEGUNDO «De 18 de junio a 1 de septiembre de 2026 (Solo si hay vacantes del primer plazo en Másteres sin Listas de Espera)», with the second round possibly brought forward to 4 June for masters that have not filled. Resolution deadlines: 1º plazo 27 May 2026, 2º plazo 8 September 2026; all applications validated by the CEP by 14 May 2026. These are 2026-27 dates and are NOT shifted forward a year.
application_rounds: curso 2026-27 (NOT 2027-28) PRIMER PLAZO: 4 February – 8 April 2026; CEP validation complete by 14 May 2026; resolution deadline 27 May 2026
curso 2026-27 SEGUNDO PLAZO: 18 June – 1 September 2026 (may open early on 4 June where places remain); resolution deadline 8 September 2026

(2) A non-Spanish access degree requires the Ministry's certificación de equivalencia de nota media, which takes time to obtain — so the February–April window must be started early. UAM also advertises a «proceso de admisión temprana para estudiantes de sistemas educativos extranjeros que residan fuera de España»; its specific dates were NOT found and NEED A HUMAN. entry_requirements: Preferred technical profiles: Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering. Secondary preference: Economics, Marketing, Business Administration with statistical content. Candidates may be rejected if the profile lacks relevance to the named disciplines. ⚠️ SEPARATE NON-EEES GATE: «Los estudiantes procedentes de sistemas educativos ajenos al Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior (EEES) deben obtener el permiso que otorga la UCM para acceder a estudios de máster oficial» and «La matrícula a un máster no será definitiva hasta que no se le haya concedido el Permiso de Acceso.» This is an extra, mandatory UCM authorisation step for a Tunisian applicant, handled by the Negociado de Convalidaciones (convalid@ucm.es), and it must be started early.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Nuevas Tecnologías Electrónicas y Fotónicas
programme_name_en: Master in New Electronic and Photonic Technologies (unofficial rendering; no registered English title)
institution: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (UCM) — Facultad de Ciencias Físicas
modality: presencial — the programme site describes a full-time, in-person programme that «can be extended to 2 years if combining work and studies».
language_of_instruction: Castellano — UCM official ficha, Curso 2026/2027, field verbatim: "Idiomas en los que se imparte | Castellano". Spanish-only; no English track.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — UCM's fees page is explicitly headed academic year 2026/2027.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — UCM-wide, same mechanism as the other UCM masters. Verbatim from UCM's own non-EU information sheet: «Los estudiantes ajenos al EEES no residentes en España se les aplicará el precio público correspondiente a 3ª matrícula (Decreto 72/2017, de 1 de agosto).» UCM 2026/2027 general master rates: 1ª matrícula 45,02 €/crédito, 2ª 71,88, 3ª y sucesivas 84,07. So a non-EU non-resident pays 84,07 rather than 45,02 — an 87% uplift. The same sheet warns «Tenga en cuenta que la situación de "estancia" no es equivalente a la situación de "residencia"». NOTE: this master carries prácticas externas and sits in the Ciencias rama; if UCM applies a different nivel de experimentalidad to Facultad de Ciencias Físicas masters the per-credit figure could differ from the general rate. That was NOT checked and is a live uncertainty.
entry_requirements: An official university degree from Spain, the EHEA, or an equivalent/authorised non-EHEA credential. Recommended backgrounds: graduates in PHYSICS, MATHEMATICS or ENGINEERING; applicants from other scientific fields are accepted «provided the student has an adequate physics-mathematics foundation». 25 places per admission cycle. From 2025-26 applicants may enrol while still owing only a final thesis and at most 9 ECTS. The UCM non-EEES Permiso de Acceso applies as for all UCM masters: «La matrícula a un máster no será definitiva hasta que no se le haya concedido el Permiso de Acceso.»
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT BUT WEAK IN PRACTICE — "Engineering" is named among the recommended backgrounds, but the gate is an «adequate physics-mathematics foundation» and the curriculum is photonics/instrumentation/nanotechnology. A software engineering graduate would be admitted on paper and out of his depth in optics and precision electronic measurement. This is a poor match for the candidate's background, independent of the path-C label.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level — the register publishes Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0 for 4313963 (60 ECTS = 24 obligatorios + 24 optativos + 6 prácticas externas + 6 TFM). No applicant-level complementos rule is published on either UCM page — "not mentioned".
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND — no reconocimiento de créditos or advanced-standing statement on the pages fetched. UCM's general «Reglamento de transferencia y solicitud de reconocimiento de créditos» exists institution-wide but was not referenced on this programme's pages.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for the September 2027 (curso 2027-28) intake. UCM's catalogue page for this master simply refers applicants to https://www.ucm.es/proceso-de-admision-masteres for current dates. The programme's own site names a «Third admission period: September 1-4», consistent with UCM's 2026-27 extraordinary round of 1–4 September 2026. The full 2026-27 UCM master's calendar (first ordinary round 28 January – 20 February 2026, second 27 April – 22 May 2026, extraordinary 1–4 September 2026) is recorded under the UCM data-science record in this batch and is index-derived, not confirmed on a fetched calendar page.
application_rounds: curso 2026-27 (NOT 2027-28) third/extraordinary admission period: 1–4 September (confirmed on the programme's own site as «Third admission period: September 1-4»)
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — because of the UCM Permiso de Acceso for non-EEES applicants, whose grant is a precondition of a definitive enrolment. The September extraordinary round is far too late for a non-EU applicant needing a visa; the January–February first round is the realistic target.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND — the programme site routes to a contact form at /master-electronicayfotonica/contacto. Coordinator named as José Luis Imaña Pascual. convalid@ucm.es handles the non-EEES access permit; admisionmasteres@ucm.es handles general master admissions.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS = 24 obligatorios + 24 optativos + 6 ECTS prácticas externas + 6 ECTS TFM (RUCT 4313963). Compulsory: Photonic Devices; Precision Electronic Measurements; OPTICAL AND DIGITAL SIGNAL/IMAGE PROCESSING; IoT Sensor Node Programming; Internship; Master's Thesis. Choose 4 electives from Electromagnetic Compatibility, Integrated Circuit Design, Lasers and Optical Metrology, Robotics and Mechatronics, Digital Optics. ⚠️ PATH-C VERDICT: the only signal-processing content is a single compulsory course on OPTICAL and digital signal/IMAGE processing — optics and imaging, not audio. NO audio, acoustics or audio-DSP content whatsoever. The wave-1 note called this UCM's nearest official path-C candidate because UCM has no telecommunications-engineering master; that remains true, and it remains a weak fit. Rank low for path C.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Coordinator José Luis Imaña Pascual; Facultad de Ciencias Físicas, UCM. Emphasis on instrumentation, optics, electronics, microsystems and nanotechnology.
industry_links: 6 ECTS of compulsory prácticas externas (internship) — the only programme in this batch with a mandatory internship in the verified plan.
thesis_or_internship: BOTH: 6 ECTS prácticas externas (compulsory) + 6 ECTS TFM.

programme_name_es: Máster de Formación Permanente en Big Data, Data Science e Inteligencia Artificial
institution: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (UCM) — Centro de Formación Permanente, Facultad de Estudios Estadísticos
institution_type: public university, own-title (título propio) offering through its continuing-education centre
official_status: título propio — specifically a «Máster de Formación Permanente», which is the post-RD 822/2021 legal name for a título propio. UCM's own catalogue labels it as such. IT IS NOT AN OFFICIAL MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO: it is not ANECA-verified, does not appear in RUCT, does NOT grant PhD access, and is normally ineligible for public scholarships. It is marketed identically to the official kind — this is exactly the distinction the brief calls the single most consequential one.
modality: online — UCM's catalogue records «Modalidad: Online». Dates run 25-09-2026 to 02-06-2028, i.e. about 21 months, not the 12 the 60-ECTS load might suggest.
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND — no idioma de impartición field is published on the UCM catalogue entry. All materials are in Spanish and the programme is run by a Spanish faculty for a Spanish market, which strongly suggests Spanish, but no explicit statement was found and the brief forbids inferring it. NEEDS A HUMAN.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — the UCM catalogue entry is explicitly filed under academic year 2026/2027 and carries edition dates 25-09-2026 to 02-06-2028.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — and for a structural reason. A título propio is priced by the university itself, not by the Comunidad de Madrid precios públicos decree, so the 3ª-matrícula repricing that hits non-EU non-residents on UCM's OFFICIAL masters (84,07 vs 45,02 €/crédito) does not apply here. UCM publishes one flat price of 4805 € with no EU/non-EU differential. Recorded as NO on the basis that the price is school-set and single-valued; if a differential exists it is not published.
entry_requirements: NOT FOUND on the UCM catalogue pages — the entry references a «Requisitos de Acceso» section whose content was not served. 300 places, which is an unusually large cohort and implies a low selection bar.
accepts_engineering_background: NOT FOUND — no admitted-background list published on the UCM pages. Inference from the 300-place cohort and continuing-education framing is that admission is broad, but that is an inference, not a fact.
complementary_credits_required: NOT APPLICABLE — complementos de formación are a feature of official másteres universitarios. RUCT publishes nothing because the programme is not in RUCT, which is EXPECTED for a título propio and is not evidence of a defect.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND — and note that credits from a título propio are themselves poorly transferable into official study, which is a further reason this route does not serve a candidate whose 300 ECTS is aimed at PhD-capable qualifications.
application_window_2027: NOT APPLICABLE TO A SEPTEMBER 2027 START AS PUBLISHED. The edition on offer runs 25-09-2026 to 02-06-2028 — it STARTS in September 2026, a year before the candidate's target intake, and finishes in June 2028. A 2027-starting edition is NOT PUBLISHED. Application/pre-enrolment dates were not served on the UCM page.
non_eu_early_round_advised: NOT FOUND
admissions_contact_email: info@nticmaster.com (the contact UCM publishes for this programme — note it is a commercial provider address, not a ucm.es address, which is itself a signal about how the programme is run)
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS. Aim: train experts in managing large volumes of data using statistical techniques, data mining and artificial intelligence; the AI content was expanded to reflect current enterprise practice. Directed by Javier Portela García-Miguel (who also coordinates UCM's OFFICIAL Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos e Inteligencia de Negocios — the two are run by the same person out of the same faculty, one official and one not), co-directed by José Carlos Soto Gómez. UCM programme code 2026-24300-013. External programme site: masterbigdataucm.com.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Facultad de Estudios Estadísticos, UCM. Director Javier Portela García-Miguel; co-director José Carlos Soto Gómez.
industry_links: Delivered with an external commercial partner (contact address info@nticmaster.com; external site masterbigdataucm.com). Not verified further.
thesis_or_internship: NOT FOUND
conflicts: PRICE: UCM's own catalogue entry publishes 4805 € for the ONLINE edition filed under 2026/2027. Third-party and programme-marketing sources circulate a figure of 6.955 € plus a 40 € pre-registration fee for a 9th-edition PRESENCIAL variant. These are probably different modalities (UCM lists at least two catalogue entries, ..._2 and ..._3), not a contradiction about the same product, but only the 4805 € online figure is verified on a ucm.es page and only that is recorded. The presencial variant's price is NOT FOUND on a university domain.
DURATION: 60 ECTS would normally be one academic year, but the published edition runs 25-09-2026 to 02-06-2028, about 21 months. Recorded as published.

notes: ⛔ THE HEADLINE IS THE QUALIFICATION TYPE, NOT THE PRICE. This is a título propio / Máster de Formación Permanente. It gives NO PhD access, is not ANECA-verified, is absent from RUCT (expected, not a defect), and is normally ineligible for public scholarships — while costing 4.805 €, which is roughly what a non-EU non-resident pays for UCM's OFFICIAL 60-ECTS data-science master (5.044,20 € at 84,07 €/crédito) and nearly double what an EU resident pays for it (2.701,20 €). For a candidate whose funding availability is a primary ranking factor and who holds a 300-ECTS degree plausibly aimed at doctoral study, this is close to the worst value proposition in the batch. programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Análisis de Datos para la Inteligencia de Negocios
institution: Universidad de Oviedo — Facultad de Ciencias
modality: presencial — the programme page states PRESENCIAL. Four semesters across two academic years.
language_of_instruction: "Castellano" — stated verbatim as the idioma de impartición on the Universidad de Oviedo's own programme page. HARD LANGUAGE FILTER: a two-year, 120-ECTS quantitative master taught entirely in Spanish is not realistically accessible to a candidate at A0/A1 now, even reaching B1-B2 by September 2027.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no certificate level published. The binding constraint is Castellano teaching.
tuition_year_of_rates: As published on the Universidad de Oviedo programme page on 2026-08-25. The page prints the rate table without an explicit academic year; the 21,84 €/crédito first-enrolment figure matches the Asturias Decreto de Precios Públicos 2026-2027 (nivel de experimentalidad II, 1ª matrícula), so the table is read as 2026-27. FLAGGED as an inference from the matching figure.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit and quantified on the university's own programme page, which publishes two separate columns: Spanish/EU citizens and eligible nationalities pay 21,84 €/crédito on first enrolment (45,10 on second, 88,16 on third and subsequent), while NON-EU STUDENTS pay 45,10 €/crédito on every enrolment including the first. That is the second-enrolment rate applied from the outset — the same penalty-tier mechanism Madrid uses, and a 106% uplift. Legal basis: the Asturias Decreto de Precios Públicos 2026-2027 art. 1.2 authorises the university to differentiate the credit price for non-resident foreigners over 18 excluding EU nationals, up to 100% of cost («el precio de la matrícula podrá cubrir hasta el 100% de los costes»); the decree does not fix the figure, so the university's own published tariff is the operative source — which is exactly what is used here.
entry_requirements: Optimal entry profile: degrees with substantial coursework in mathematics, accounting, finance, economics, business administration, commerce, marketing, ENGINEERING or similar. Universidad de Oviedo grados named as preferred: Matemáticas, Contabilidad y Finanzas, Economía, ADE, Comercio y Marketing. 20 places. General master access rules at https://cei.uniovi.es/postgrado/masteres/accesoyadmision; applicants from non-EHEA systems must supply a certificate that the degree gives access to master's study in the awarding country.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT BUT SECONDARY — "engineering" appears in the optimal-profile list, but every named preferred degree is a mathematics/economics/business grado from Oviedo itself. This is a quantitative-business master whose default intake is economists and mathematicians, not software engineers. A Software Engineering graduate is admissible; the ECONOMÍA complemento (below) is the likely consequence.
complementary_credits_required: ★ THE ONLY PROGRAMME IN THIS BATCH WITH A QUANTIFIED, NAMED APPLICANT-LEVEL COMPLEMENTOS SCHEME. The programme publishes two 4,5-ECTS foundation modules for students lacking adequate preparation: MATEMÁTICAS (4,5 ECTS) and ECONOMÍA (4,5 ECTS) — i.e. up to 9 ECTS in total. For this candidate the Matemáticas module is very unlikely to be required (a 300-ECTS software engineering degree carries far more mathematics than 4,5 ECTS), but the ECONOMÍA module is a realistic imposition, since his background contains no economics at all. Register position: output/ruct-detail.jsonl records ects_complementos_formativos as null for 4315881 — NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — while a wave-1 note reported 4,5 ECTS complementos declared in the register. The RUCT detail page returned HTTP 503 on re-fetch here so the discrepancy could not be resolved; both readings are logged as a conflict. The programme page's 4,5 + 4,5 scheme is the figure to rely on because it is the applicant-level rule and it was directly fetched.
credit_recognition_available: MECHANISM EXISTS, NO ENTITLEMENT PUBLISHED. The programme page points to Universidad de Oviedo's postgraduate regulations at http://cei.uniovi.es/postgrado/masteres/normativa for reconocimiento de créditos, but no rule addresses a 300-ECTS prior degree and no quantity is promised. The practical question for this candidate is narrower and more answerable: can a 300-ECTS engineering transcript WAIVE the 4,5-ECTS Matemáticas complemento (almost certainly yes) and the Economía one (probably not)? That should be put to the coordinators directly.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for the September 2027 (curso 2027-28) intake. For curso 2026-2027 the Universidad de Oviedo published a periodo extraordinario with preinscripción «Del 3 al 31 de agosto de 2026», provisional lists 04/09/2026, reclamaciones 07-09/09/2026, listas definitivas 11/09/2026, matrícula 14-16/09/2026. These are 2026-27 dates and are NOT shifted forward a year. The ordinary-period dates were not captured.
application_rounds: curso 2026-27 (NOT 2027-28) periodo extraordinario: preinscripción 3–31 August 2026; listas provisionales 4 September 2026; reclamaciones 7–9 September 2026; listas definitivas 11 September 2026; matrícula 14–16 September 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: NOT STATED as a rule, but applicants from non-EHEA systems must first obtain a certificate that their degree gives access to master's study in the awarding country, and Ministry grade-equivalence certification where a grade comparison is needed — both slow. An extraordinary period closing on 31 August with enrolment in mid-September leaves no visa runway at all, so the ordinary period is the only realistic route for a Tunisian applicant.
admissions_contact_email: ameliab@uniovi.es (Amelia María Bilbao Terol, coordinator); mmontenegro@uniovi.es (Manuel Francisco Montenegro Hermida, coordinator); fac.ciencias@uniovi.es (Facultad de Ciencias)
curriculum_summary: 120 ECTS over two years (four semesters). RUCT breakdown: obligatorios not published (null), 45 optativos, 6 ECTS prácticas externas, 12 ECTS TFM. Rama Ciencias Sociales y Jurídicas, campo Matemáticas y estadística. Business-intelligence-led data analysis run out of the Facultad de Ciencias with the economics/business faculties. Sits across paths AB and X. No audio or music content.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Coordinators Amelia María Bilbao Terol and Manuel Francisco Montenegro Hermida, Facultad de Ciencias, Universidad de Oviedo.
industry_links: 6 ECTS of prácticas externas in the verified plan.
thesis_or_internship: BOTH: 6 ECTS prácticas externas + 12 ECTS TFM.
scholarships_internal: Gratuidad de matrícula de máster financiada por el Principado de Asturias — income-tested; requires having applied for the MEC beca or declaring you do not meet its economic requirements, and not already holding an equivalent master-level qualification. Whether a non-EU applicant with no Spanish residency qualifies is NOT resolved. https://www.uniovi.es/estudia/masteres/sobrelosmasteres/becas/principado

The RUCT detail page returned HTTP 503 when re-fetched on 2026-08-25, so this could not be adjudicated. SCHOLARSHIP vs FEE: Universidad de Oviedo advertises «MATRÍCULA GRATUITA DE MÁSTERES PARA EL CURSO 2026-2027» on its postgraduate fees page while the Asturias decree still fixes a credit price. programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Data Science
language_of_instruction: «Lengua de docencia: Castellano» - the UV official data sheet gives Castellano as the single language of delivery. The English version of the site is a translation, not evidence of English teaching (rule 7). HARD BLOCKER at A0/A1.
language_requirement: «Para estudiantes de países de habla no hispana se requiere Acreditación B2 de español (a través de un Diploma de Español como Lengua Extranjera en un nivel de B2, o en su caso, prueba oral y escrita)». A DELE B2 in Spanish is therefore a formal admission requirement for this candidate. English at B1+ counts only as a minor admission merit (5% band).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27. Anexo I item 2.2 of Decreto 101/2024 (DOGV 9913, 12/08/2024) sets «Estudios de máster no comprendidos en el grupo anterior» at 35,34 EUR/crédito, 1a matrícula; Decreto 122/2026, de 4 de agosto, del Consell modifies Decreto 101/2024 and keeps the enrolment prices frozen for curso 2026-2027. The UV programme sheet shows the same 35,34 / 70,68 pair.
non_eu_surcharge: YES - EXPLICIT AND DOUBLE. The UV official data sheet publishes two credit prices side by side: «Precio del crédito primera matrícula: 35.34€» and «Estudiantes extranjeros no UE: 70.68€». Legal base: Decreto 101/2024, de 2 de agosto, del Consell, art. 6.1 - «Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea ..., se le aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos en el anexo I ..., sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del cien por cien (100%) del coste del servicio académico». Art. 6.3 closes the escape route: «la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes» - a Spanish study visa does NOT make this candidate a resident. The 1.5x transitional rate in Disposición transitoria primera applied only to curso 2024-2025, so the full doubling applies now.
entry_requirements: «Se requiere formación previa de nivel grado o superior en áreas como: Matemáticas, Física, Ingenierías (Informática, Electrónica, Telecomunicación e Industriales), Economía, y Administración y Dirección de Empresas.» Candidates must show competence in mathematics and statistics, prior use of programming tools (R, C, Matlab, Python or similar) and knowledge of programming fundamentals and databases. 25 plazas. Admission is scored: adecuación al perfil de ingreso 50%, expediente académico 40%, experiencia profesional en análisis de datos 5%, otros méritos (titulaciones adicionales, idiomas B1+, seminarios) 5%. Spanish B2 accreditation required for applicants from non-Spanish-speaking countries.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT - «Ingenierías (Informática, ...)» is named in the recommended entry profile, and it is the 50%-weighted admission criterion.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level - the register records ects_complementos_formativos = 0. AT APPLICANT LEVEL the programme states: «Aquellos cuya formación previa sea insuficiente en los conocimientos requeridos deberán cursar complementos formativos establecidos en la memoria del programa» (section 4.6 of the memoria), judged by the Comisión Académica on mathematics/statistics/programming competence. So RUCT's 0 does NOT guarantee an applicant is exempt - this is one of the cases the brief warns about. A Software Engineering graduate would normally clear the programming test; the maths/statistics component is the one to evidence.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND - no statement of advanced standing or reconocimiento de créditos for a 300-ECTS first degree on the programme, data-sheet or admission pages. The 300 ECTS is useful here only as surplus over the entry bar; the master remains 90 ECTS over two courses.
application_window_2027: 2026-27 calendar (published; 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25). Fase 1: 30 March - 21 April 2026, 23:59. Fase 2: 25 May - 16 June 2026, 14:00. Fase Extraordinaria: 22-31 July and 24 August - 2 September 2026, 23:59. Dates are NOT shifted forward a year - the September 2027 intake calendar is not out.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES, urgently. A holder of a degree from outside the EHEA that is not homologated must pay a 155,22 EUR «estudio de equivalencia» fee and, critically, «Obtaining the equivalence resolution is a requirement for the evaluation of the pre-enrolment application» - the application is not even assessed until the equivalence resolution is issued. A Tunisian degree holder must therefore enter in Fase 1 (the March-April window) to leave time for that resolution.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND - UV routes pre-enrolment queries through its «Support and Enquiries» web form rather than publishing an address. Programme director: Emilio Soria Olivas (ETSE-UV).
curriculum_summary: 90 ECTS over two academic years. RUCT breakdown: 65 obligatorios, 0 optativos, 10 prácticas externas, 15 TFM. Taught at the Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería (ETSE-UV), Avenida de la Universitat s/n, 46100 Burjassot. The 10-ECTS compulsory external placement is unusual among Spanish data-science masters and is a real industry hook.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Director Emilio Soria Olivas (ETSE-UV; machine-learning / intelligent data analysis group IDAL). Escola Tècnica Superior d'Enginyeria.
industry_links: 10 ECTS of compulsory prácticas externas built into the title (RUCT), i.e. a mandatory company placement. Specific partner companies NOT FOUND on the pages read.
thesis_or_internship: Both: 10 ECTS prácticas externas + 15 ECTS Trabajo Fin de Máster.

notes: *** WAVE-1 TASK ITEM CLOSED: the UAH fee figures are now PINNED TO A YEAR. *** The UAH programme page carries them under an explicit «(curso 2026-27)» label - «1ª matrícula: españoles y residentes: 2.736 € ; extracomunitarios no residentes: 5.079 €» - so they satisfy rule 4 and no longer need to be cross-derived from the decree. ARITHMETIC CHECK, which also explains the odd cents: the Comunidad de Madrid tariff is 45,02 EUR/crédito (1a matrícula, máster no habilitante) and 84,07 EUR/crédito for extracomunitarios no residentes. 45,02 x 60 = 2.701,20 and 84,07 x 60 = 5.044,20. UAH's published totals are 2.736 and 5.079 - exactly 34,80 EUR more in BOTH cases. So UAH's headline figures are tuition + a fixed 34,80 EUR of compulsory administrative charges (secretaría / seguro escolar / carné). The exact composition of that 34,80 EUR is NOT FOUND and is not asserted here; what is certain is that it is a constant, not a surcharge. additional_fees_eur is recorded as the 250 EUR reserva de plaza, which is a separate up-front payment due within three days of admission; whether it is later deducted from the matrícula is NOT FOUND. non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED AND PINNED (this field previously read NOT FOUND and has been CORRECTED against source). Universidad de Murcia's own 'Precios públicos' rules page states verbatim: "Las y los estudiantes extranjeros no comunitarios no residentes y estudiantes visitantes que se matriculen por primera vez en la Universidad de Murcia deberán abonar los derechos de secretaría que correspondan, además de los precios por la prestación de servicios académicos universitarios calculados según lo indicado en el artículo 21, incrementados en un 20%." The uplift applies whether it is a first, second or subsequent enrolment. So UM DOES exercise the power the regional decree grants it — Decreto n.º 8/2024 (Región de Murcia) art. 6.5: "Las universidades podrán diferenciar el precio del crédito hasta cubrir el 100 por 100 de los costes de las enseñanzas universitarias de grado y máster cuando se trate de estudiantes extranjeros mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquéllos a quienes sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, sin perjuicio del principio de reciprocidad" — but it exercises it at +20 per cent, far below the 100-per-cent-of-cost ceiling that decree permits. OLDER, DIFFERENT RULE STILL PUBLISHED ON THE SAME SITE (logged, not silently reconciled): a UM Consejo de Gobierno document of 28/09/2012 states that from curso 2013-2014 non-EU non-resident students "les serán de aplicación las tarifas fijadas para los estudiantes visitantes" (visiting-student tariffs) rather than a percentage uplift. language_of_instruction: ENGLISH. Verbatim from the official Unizar programme page: "El objetivo del máster es proporcionar una formación de investigación, innovación y desarrollo en los ámbitos de Robótica, Gráficos y Visión por Computador. La lengua de impartición es el inglés." Corroborated by the plan de estudios, whose subject titles are all in English, and by the TFM rule: "El resultado se plasma en una memoria en forma de artículo o informe, escrito en inglés".
language_requirement: B2 English or higher, verbatim: "Para todos los títulos deberá acreditarse al menos nivel B2 de Inglés o equivalente, aunque se valorarán niveles superiores." NO Spanish requirement — Unizar's general rule only demands proof of Spanish where the master is taught in Spanish, which this one is not.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (DECRETO del Gobierno de Aragón de 24 de junio de 2026, BOA 29/06/2026; official Unizar price table 'Enseñanzas de Máster Universitario. Precios Públicos: Curso académico 2026-2027')
non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED, EXACTLY DOUBLE, AND UNAVOIDABLE ON A STUDENT VISA. The Unizar 2026-27 master price table has a dedicated non-EU row: for EINA masters including 'Robótica, Gráficos y Visión por Computador/Robotics, Graphics and Computer Vision' the entry reads '30,40 / 60,80' — 30,40 EUR/ECTS for 'Españoles, residentes o ciudadanos UE 1ª matrícula' and 60,80 EUR/ECTS for 'Ciudadanos no UE / Non-EU citizens. Credit price 1st. Registration' (2nd enrolment 60,76 / 121,52). Crucially, Unizar states verbatim: "La condición de residente se acreditará mediante la tarjeta de Identificación de Extranjeros (TIE) donde se indique que el tipo de permiso es por RESIDENCIA. El permiso por ESTANCIA o permiso por ESTUDIOS no es válido para acreditar la condición de residente, a efectos del pago de los precios de matrícula." A Tunisian arriving on a student visa therefore pays the non-EU rate. Unizar does publish an 'AYUDAS DE MATRÍCULA para estudiantes extranjeros no residentes' call that can offset this.
entry_requirements: Access degrees, verbatim: "Ingeniería Informática; Ingeniería Electrónica y Automática (1); Ingeniería de Tecnologías Industriales (1); Ingeniería de Tecnologías y Servicios de Telecomunicación (1); Ingeniería Mecatrónica (1); Ingeniería Eléctrica (1); Ingeniería Mecánica (1); Física (1); Matemáticas (1); Otros títulos universitarios oficiales de grado en Ingeniería o Ciencias (1, 2)". Verbatim on the (1)/(2) markers: "Para las titulaciones marcadas (1), (1, 2), para el acceso directo al Máster deberá además acreditarse: (1) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente, por ejemplo el TFG) de programación de computadores, y (2) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente) de matemáticas." A non-EHEA degree without homologación needs a Unizar 'autorización de acceso' resolution first (access route (e)).
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT AND UNCONDITIONAL. 'Ingeniería Informática' is the FIRST listed access degree and carries NO (1) or (2) marker, i.e. it is direct access with no programming or mathematics evidence required. This is the cleanest background match in the batch.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4317156). At applicant level: NONE for a Computer Engineering graduate — the 18-ECTS programming and 18-ECTS mathematics evidence requirements apply only to the (1)/(2)-marked degrees, not to Ingeniería Informática.

RECOMMENDED ENTRY PROFILE (RD 822/2021 Anexo I knowledge fields), verbatim: "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas. Ingeniería eléctrica, ingeniería electrónica e ingeniería de la telecomunicación. Matemáticas y Estadística. Física y Astronomía. Ingeniería industrial, ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería automática, ingeniería de la organización industrial e ingeniería de la navegación. Ingeniería química, ingeniería de los materiales e ingeniería del medio natural." Verbatim on non-listed backgrounds: "Este Máster universitario en Ciencia de Datos está orientado principalmente a perfiles del ámbito de las ingenierías" — applicants from other fields are admitted only if they hold ALL of: basic mathematics (min. 150 h — probability/statistics, linear algebra); intermediate programming (min. 300 h — variables/functions, structured programming, OOP fundamentals, abstract data types); basic relational databases (min. 150 h — relational design, Entity-Relationship model, SQL); and introductory networks and computer architecture (min. 150 h — CPU/memory, operating systems, IP networks/Internet protocols, Linux at user level). "Dichos conocimientos serán evaluados por la Comisión de Admisión del máster." A preparatory course (6 subjects x 6 credits) exists for those who lack them.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT AND OPTIMAL. "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas" is the FIRST listed recommended knowledge field, and the four prior-knowledge blocks (maths, programming, databases, networks/architecture) are precisely a Software Engineering curriculum. UOC even steers non-technical applicants AWAY to a different master.
complementary_credits_required: 12 ECTS — COMPULSORY FOR EVERYONE, and this is NOT in RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4316294). Verbatim from the programme's own plan de estudios: "Para obtener la titulación de máster universitario de Ciencia de datos el estudiante tiene que superar 60 créditos ECTS entre asignaturas obligatorias y optativas y, además, 12 créditos ECTS de asignaturas niveladoras de complementos de formación." And on timing: "Este máster está adaptado al nuevo RD 822/2021 y tiene la restricción de matricular obligatoriamente las dos asignaturas de complementos de formación durante el primer curso académico, preferentemente el primer semestre... No se podrá continuar los estudios hasta que no se superen los complementos. Los complementos de formación son conocimientos de grado obligatorios para titularse del master." Every study plan on the page repeats the footnote "En esta planificación no se incluyen los 12 ECTS de complementos de formación, adicionales y obligatorios para titularse." ==> THE REAL LOAD IS 72 ECTS, NOT 60, AND THE REAL COST IS HIGHER THAN THE HEADLINE.
credit_recognition_available: YES — TWO NAMED MECHANISMS, and the most explicit credit-recognition route in this batch. Verbatim: "No debéis cursar en vuestro programa de estudios las asignaturas reconocidas mediante la evaluación de estudios previos (EEP) o del reconocimiento académico de la experiencia profesional (RAEP). Una vez se han incorporado a la matrícula, los créditos reconocidos se descuentan del total de créditos que hay que cursar para obtener el título." Recognised subjects are also charged at a reduced rate: "Precio por crédito de asignaturas convalidadas: 5,16 €/cr" (against 25,82 €/cr). THIS IS THE 300-ECTS LEVER: a 300-ECTS Software Engineering degree is the natural case for EEP against the 12 ECTS of complementos and possibly against core subjects. NOT FOUND: any published cap or guarantee — the outcome is decided case by case after requesting access.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UOC does not run fixed admission rounds — it runs semester intakes with rolling enrolment. The published next intake is "Inicio: 23 sept 2026". Access request is free and open continuously; the practical deadline is the enrolment window before each semester start. EXPECT (but do not assume) an equivalent late-September 2027 start.

The Comunitat Valenciana public price decree does not generate this figure ($50,430 for 60 ECTS is an order of magnitude above any Valencian public master price), because this is a privately-priced adscribed centre. Strictly NOT FOUND under the brief's rule (no explicit 'no surcharge' sentence was located), but the practical reading is that a non-EU applicant pays the same as everyone else — the sticker price already is the private price.
entry_requirements: Academic/administrative (Berklee graduate application, verbatim): online application; "statement of purpose" "between 400 and 500 words"; résumé/CV in English; "One letter of recommendation from a professional colleague or professor (not peers)"; official undergraduate transcripts; "Credential evaluation (if educated outside US/Canada)" — REQUIRED for a Tunisian degree; English proficiency test; bachelor's degree diploma before enrolment; "$150 non-refundable" application fee. PORTFOLIO (verbatim, and it is unusually light): "Global Entertainment and Music Business: Self-produced video presenting one innovation idea (max 1 minute, YouTube unlisted)" — one minute, one idea, NO musical performance, NO scores, NO recordings required. Sought profile (verbatim): "Professional goals of working at an executive/managerial level in a company or creating a business/organization; Prior academic success; Prior knowledge in business; Good understanding of the current situation of the entertainment industry and technology; and Leadership in professional and/or academic environments." GRADUATION BAR: "minimum letter grade of B- in each course" and "a minimum GPA of 3.00". UPV offers 40 places for 2026/27.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — the most open door in this batch for a non-music-degree applicant, though INFERRED rather than stated. No music qualification, audition or notation is required anywhere in the published requirements; the entrance evidence is a 1-minute innovation-idea video plus a business/leadership profile. "Prior knowledge in business" is listed as something the ideal candidate should demonstrate, and this candidate's evidence for it would be their working music-production/DJ practice rather than coursework — that is a judgement the admissions committee makes and NO page states that a technical degree is accepted or excluded. Contrast with the sibling SFTV master, whose portfolio demands notated orchestral compositions and which is therefore effectively closed to a non-notating producer.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row is absent (null) for this title, which is not the same as 0. No complementos/bridging mechanism is published at applicant level either; Berklee screens by portfolio and profile, not by prerequisite credits. NOT FOUND on both counts.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. No mention of reconocimiento de créditos, transfer credit or advanced standing on the programme page, the how-to-apply page, the cost page or UPV's places document. The programme is a fixed three-semester block (core + practicum + culminating experience + 4 electives) with a residence requirement for all three terms, which leaves little room for recognition even in principle. The candidate's 300 ECTS confers no identified advantage here.
application_window_2027: Three standing rounds, NO YEAR STATED on the deadlines page. Verbatim: "Early Action — Application deadline: November 1; Scholarship deadline: November 15; Admissions decisions issued by December 15"; "Regular Action — Application deadline: January 15; Scholarship deadline: February 1; Admissions decisions issued by March 15"; "Extended Action — Application deadline: March 10; Scholarship deadline: March 10; Admissions decisions issued by April 20"; plus "Scholarship application deadlines are different from the Program Application deadlines for Early and Regular action." UPV's ordinary preinscripción is NOT the route: UPV's 2026/27 places table marks this title "No aplica" under both 'Nº PLAZAS ADMISIBLES Fases 1 y 2' and 'Fase 3'.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES, STRONGLY, and for money rather than visas: the scholarship deadline is bolted to the round (15 Nov for Early, 1 Feb for Regular, and by Extended Action on 10 March the pool has been competed for twice). At a $50,430 list price the scholarship decides whether this programme is reachable at all, so Early Action is the only round worth planning for. The credential evaluation required for a non-US/Canada degree adds further lead time.
admissions_contact_email: admissionsvalencia@berklee.edu (+34 963 332 802, 09:00–17:00 Mon–Fri). Programme director: Emilien Moyon. Centre contact registered with UPV: infovalencia@berklee.edu.
curriculum_summary: Page header: "Curriculum and Courses 2026-2027 Academic Year". 60 ECTS / 34–35 US credits in three modules. CORE (Módulo Troncal): MB-551 Copyright and Contract Management (3); MB-553 Music Business Finance (3); MB-575 Music Business Seminar (1, taken in both Fall and Spring); MB-563 Data Analytics in the Music Industry (3); GS-503 Graduate Career Seminar (1); GS-500 Master's Advising (0, Fall/Spring/Summer). FINAL PROJECT (Módulo TFM): one practicum tied to the chosen concentration — MB-611 Entrepreneurship (4) OR MB-621 Live (4) OR MB-623 Record (4) — plus MB-695 Culminating Experience (6). ELECTIVES (Módulo Optativas): four courses, 12 credits total (1 Fall, 2 Spring, 1 Summer), from MTI-613 Electronic Dance Music Composition (3); MB-614 The Art of Live Entertainment (3); MB-665 The Culture and Business of Emerging Technologies and New Creative Frontiers (3); MB-557 Economics of Creative Industries (3); MB-613 The Science of Artist Management (3); MB-626 A&R and Music Artistry (3); MB-555 Global Leadership and Management (3); MB-627 Globalization and Emerging Markets (3); MB-559 Publishing and Music Supervision (3); MTI-543 Studio Video Music Production (3); MB-615 The Business of Music Marketing (3); MB-550 Music Brands and Partnerships (3); GS-595 Graduate Internship (1). GS-510 Principles of Music Research (1) is optional and does NOT count toward the degree. CONCENTRATIONS (choose one, and it drives both practicum and final project): "Live Entertainment, Entrepreneurship, and Record Industry". PATH FIT — the strongest P/S match in this batch and the one that touches this candidate's own practice: the Record Industry concentration is path P almost exactly (copyright and contract management, publishing and music supervision, A&R), the Live Entertainment concentration is path S almost exactly (The Art of Live Entertainment plus the Live practicum), and 'MB-563 Data Analytics in the Music Industry' is a genuine, if small, bridge to path X/AB. 'MTI-613 Electronic Dance Music Composition' is directly relevant to a working producer/DJ. It is NOT a technology master: no DSP, no MIR, no programming.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Programme Director Emilien Moyon. Academic Committee of the Degree (verbatim): "Simone Pilon, Executive Director, Valencia Campus/Dean of Academic Affairs; Emilien Moyon, Program Director of Global Entertainment and Music Business; Alexandre Perrin, Professor; Jorge Ignacio Serrano Cobos, Universidad Politécnica de Valencia; Martina Naretto, Senior Coordinator for Academic Assessment, Records, and Registrar Services" — note the named UPV member, further evidence the UPV title is live rather than legacy. industry_links: The strongest published industry linkage of any programme in this batch, verbatim: "50+ networking opportunities", "40+ guest speakers", an on-campus record label — "real-life projects such as the on-campus record label Disrupción Records" — and consulting projects "to develop creative solutions for real companies and start-ups, such as Sony Music Germany, Kobalt Music Group, FUGA, Chartmetric, Soundcharts, and Next Big Sound". thesis_or_internship: BOTH, and they are distinct. Practicum (4 credits, tied to the concentration) + MB-695 Culminating Experience (6 credits) = the 14-ECTS TFM in RUCT; the culminating experience is defended before "a faculty committee comprising your advisor and two other faculty members", on a published timeline ("Semester One: propose ... Semester Two: revise and refine ... notes: DISCOVERY QUESTION ANSWERED: wave 1 recorded this programme partly to settle whether the UPV-Berklee official-title mechanism is real. It is, and this page states it in the clearest terms of any Berklee Valencia page — Berklee names the UPV affiliation, links the RUCT entry itself, lists a UPV representative on the degree's academic committee, and UPV's own Consejo-de-Gobierno places document offers 40 places under ministry code 4313420 for curso 2026/2027. The same evidence chain validates the sibling SFTV record (4313419). additional_fees_usd = 150 (application fee) + 1,600 (comprehensive fee) = 1,750 USD of unavoidable published extras on top of $50,430 tuition, plus $700–$850 for the required software bundle and a $2,500 deposit credited against tuition. Berklee separately estimates indirect costs: "Housing $10,000–$12,000", "Books $300–$800", "Local transportation $300–$600", "Personal expenses $1,000", "Laptop: May be waived $3,000". ALL FIGURES USD; no EUR figure published, none invented. FOUR+ PAGES OPENED: Berklee GEMB programme page (overview, curriculum, accreditation, committee, graduation requirements), Berklee graduate application-deadlines page, Berklee how-to-apply page, Berklee graduate tuition/costs page, Berklee scholarships index and graduate-scholarships page, UPV places-offer PDF for curso 2026/2027, UPV Berklee-centre entity page, RUCT detail. FIT VERDICT: for paths P and S this is the batch's best content match and the admissions gate is genuinely open to a non-music-degree applicant (a 1-minute video, no audition, no scores). The obstacles are money ($50k list price, scholarship-dependent) and English at C1 (IELTS 7.5). Compare against the Spanish public alternatives before committing — but note none of them awards a Berklee degree alongside the official Spanish title.
