programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería Acústica
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Acoustic Engineering
modality: semipresencial — 'Metodología semi-presencial'; face-to-face activity is concentrated in one or two afternoons a week, late October to June, at the ETSIT.
language_of_instruction: Spanish (castellano) — UNCONFIRMED BY AN EXPLICIT 'idioma de impartición' STATEMENT. No such statement exists on the UMA programme pages opened; the Visión General page carries only the site-wide notice 'El contenido original está en español', and all asignatura names and guías docentes are Spanish. Treat as Spanish-only. Do NOT infer English from the uma.es English interface.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no language certificate requirement published on the access/matriculación pages.
tuition_year_of_rates: Anexo I of Decreto 98/2023 applies 'a partir del curso académico 2023-2024' and stays in force 'en tanto no se aprueben nuevos precios públicos' (Disp. final primera, consolidated text 15/09/2025) — i.e. these are the rates currently in force and were unchanged for 2025-26. 2027-28 rates NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: CONDITIONAL — and the condition is favourable to this candidate. Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 does NOT fix a non-EU price: 'El estudiantado extranjero mencionado en el apartado 1 que no sea residente en España abonará los precios ... previstos en este decreto. No obstante, las universidades en que se matricule podrán establecer una variación en el precio de los créditos en cualquier nivel de estudios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio académico'. Andalucía therefore behaves like Cataluña/Asturias — the real figure is on the UNIVERSITY's tariff. UMA's own máster tariff annex resolves it: the ordinary rates apply provisionally to foreign nationals over 18 who hold neither residency NOR 'la autorización de estancia por estudios' — i.e. a student stay authorisation is EXPRESSLY sufficient to keep the ordinary rate at UMA (unlike Catalonia's Decret, where a long-stay study authorisation explicitly does not equal residency). Proof must be filed at the Centre's Secretaría before 1 November; otherwise UMA issues 'una liquidación complementaria que podrá alcanzar el 100% del coste real de la prestación de los citados servicios'. CAVEAT: the tariff annex read carries the 2023/24 heading; the residency clause is standard UMA boilerplate but the 2027-28 wording is unverified.
entry_requirements: Access per the Distrito Único Andaluz rules. Holders of foreign (non-EHEA) degrees may enter WITHOUT homologación: 'los titulados de sistemas educativos extranjeros ... podrán acceder a este Máster sin necesidad de la homologación de sus títulos, previa comprobación de que acreditan un nivel de formación equivalente a los correspondientes títulos españoles y que facultan en el país expedidor del título para el acceso a estudios de posgrado'. Where demand exceeds places, selection weighs prior academic training, professional experience, a possible (remote) interview, and real availability for the in-person sessions.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT for the engineering family. The perfil de ingreso names 'recién graduado en el contexto de las telecomunicaciones' (Ingeniería de Sonido e Imagen) as the core profile and additionally admits graduates of architecture, industrial engineering, environmental sciences and health engineering. A Software Engineering degree is NOT named on that list — it is an engineering degree but not one of the enumerated profiles, so admission is plausible but NOT explicitly guaranteed. Flag as INFERRED for this specific background.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos is null in the RUCT record — the register does not publish the row; this is NOT the same as 0). No complementos de formación are mentioned on the UMA Visión General or Contenidos pages either. Applicant-level complementos cannot be excluded.
credit_recognition_available: YES in principle, case by case. The Contenidos y convalidaciones page states 'Es posible que, debido a tu formación previa, puedas convalidar alguna(s) asignatura(s) del máster' and routes the applicant to the programme coordinators / UMA's general reconocimiento de créditos procedure for masters. No figure, cap or 300-ECTS-specific rule is published. The 60 ECTS comprise 6 obligatorias + 3 of 4 optativas + prácticas + TFM, so the recognisable surface is the taught subjects only.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. Distrito Único Andaluz calendar for 2026-27 (the closest published cycle): FASE 1, RESERVED FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS — applications 13–29 January 2026, adjudication lists 19 February, 12 March and 9 April 2026. FASE 2 (ordinaria, Spanish and international) — applications 17–26 June 2026, adjudications 22 July and 14 September 2026. FASE 3 — applications 8–15 September 2026, adjudications 29 September and 9 October 2026.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fase 1 (international applicants only): 13–29 January 2026
2026-27 Fase 2 (ordinaria): 17–26 June 2026
2026-27 Fase 3: 8–15 September 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — STRONGLY, and this is structural, not advisory. Andalucía runs a dedicated FASE 1 for international applicants that closes in JANUARY, roughly eight months before the intake. A candidate targeting September 2027 should expect to apply around January 2027 in the equivalent phase. Missing it pushes you into the June ordinary phase where places compete against the domestic pool.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND — the programme pages route enquiries to the UMA Servicio de Acceso (Máster) rather than publishing a programme mailbox.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS at the Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería de Telecomunicación (ETSIT): 6 asignaturas obligatorias, 3 optativas chosen from 4, prácticas en empresas and a Trabajo Fin de Máster. RUCT breakdown: 30 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 5 prácticas + 10 TFM. Project-based, taught in afternoon blocks so it can be combined with employment. Acoustic engineering rather than music technology: relevant to path C (audio/DSP) and adjacent to A, but it is not a sound-and-music-computing programme.
notable_faculty_or_lab: ETSIT, Universidad de Málaga. Specific faculty not captured.
industry_links: Prácticas en empresas are a credited component (5 ECTS in the RUCT breakdown). The programme explicitly targets employed postgraduates seeking acoustic specialisation, which shapes the evening timetable.
thesis_or_internship: Both: prácticas en empresas (5 ECTS) + Trabajo Fin de Máster (10 ECTS).
notes: COST ARITHMETIC. Andalucía prices masters in two bands only — there is no experimentality split for masters, unlike Canarias. UMA's own tariff annex: 'El precio de las primeras matrículas de los másteres habilitantes queda fijado en 12,62 euros y el de los no habilitantes en 13,68 €. El resto de precios es común a todos los másteres.' WHICH BAND APPLIES HERE IS THE DECISIVE DETAIL: the UMA matriculación page for this master states that 'a partir del curso 2017/18 el MIA adquirió la condición de máster asimilado a habilitante, lo que le asigna unas tarifas de matrícula inferiores a las de los másteres no habilitantes'. So the 12,62 band applies, NOT 13,68. 12,62 EUR/ECTS x 60 ECTS = 757,20 EUR for the whole programme in first enrolment. (Had it been non-habilitante: 13,68 x 60 = 820,80 — recorded here so the 63,60 EUR difference is traceable.) Repeat enrolments are far dearer: 2ª matrícula 27,35, 3ª 59,26, 4ª y sucesivas 82,06 EUR/crédito for the Ingenierías group. ADD apertura de expediente académico 59,10 EUR (figure updated by Decreto 142/2025) and tarjeta de identidad 5,70 EUR; expedición del título de máster 176,00 EUR at the end; seguro escolar applies only to under-28s. The Andalucía 99% bonificación on credits passed at first attempt (art. 12) requires prior enrolment at an Andalusian public university in the preceding two years, so it does NOT help a first-year incoming international student. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: the UMA tariff annex PDF that carries the per-credit table and the foreign-student clause is headed 'Curso Académico 2023/2024'; Decreto 98/2023's Disposición final primera keeps Anexo I in force until superseded, and the September 2025 modification (Decreto 142/2025) touched only the administrative-services block, so 12,62/13,68 are still the standing figures — but a 2025-26-dated UMA table was not located and this should be re-checked by a human. The Anexo I table in the consolidated BOJA text is an embedded image and could not be read as text.

modality: presencial (3 semesters). A part-time route at 30 ECTS/year with roughly one and a half days of class per week is offered.
language_of_instruction: 'Español, Inglés' — verbatim from the UVa official plan record. Genuinely bilingual, not an artefact of an English webpage: UVa's Relaciones Internacionales publishes a full 30-ECTS semester delivered entirely in English within this master. Spanish is nonetheless used for part of the teaching, so this is NOT an English-only programme.
language_requirement: English B1 (CEFR) required for admission; B2 recommended. No Spanish certificate requirement published — but given the plan is Spanish/English, functional Spanish is realistically needed.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (Decreto 8/2024 de 30 de mayo, BOCyL 3/06/2024, set for 2024-25 and prorrogado to 2025-26; Disposición final primera auto-extends where no new decree is approved). 2027-28 rates NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — verified by reading the decree, not by silence on a programme page. Decreto 8/2024 contains NO article on estudiantes extranjeros / no comunitarios / no residentes en España, and no clause delegating a non-EU price to the universities. One scale applies to everyone in Castilla y León. This is the mechanism to note: CyL differs from Madrid/La Rioja/Valencia (distinct published non-EU tariff) AND from Cataluña/Asturias/Andalucía (decree authorises the university to charge up to 100% of cost).
entry_requirements: Official university degree or EHEA-equivalent. Priority to graduates in forestry / natural resources OR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY fields. English B1 required. 20 places.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. The access rules name Information Technology degrees (Informática, Estadística) as a priority entry route alongside the forestry ones, and the master is deliberately designed to take both intakes. A Software Engineering graduate enters via the IT route.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row is absent for 4316066). credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND for a 300-ECTS entrant. No reconocimiento de créditos rule specific to this title was published. Structurally there is unusual headroom compared with the other programmes in this batch — RUCT records 33 ECTS of optativos out of 90 — but nothing states that prior study can be recognised against them.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. admissions_contact_email: master.gestion.forestal@uva.es

notable_faculty_or_lab: iuFOR (Instituto Universitario de Investigación en Gestión Forestal Sostenible, UVa–INIA) collaborates in the programme; E.T.S. de Ingenierías Agrarias, Palencia.
industry_links: 6 ECTS prácticas in the RUCT structure; those with a forestry background take 3 credits of R&D practice as the alternative to the bridging course.
thesis_or_internship: Both: prácticas 6 ECTS + Trabajo Fin de Máster 12 ECTS.
notes: COST ARITHMETIC. Castilla y León, DECRETO 8/2024 de 30 de mayo (BOCyL núm. 106, 3 June 2024), Anexo II: 'Másteres que NO habilitan para el ejercicio de actividades profesionales reguladas' = 26,20 EUR/crédito primera matrícula (2ª/3ª/4ª y sucesivas all 76,21); habilitantes = 16,34. non_eu_surcharge: YES — +25%, AND THE EXEMPTION LIST EXCLUDES TUNISIA. Two-step mechanism, as the brief predicts for Galicia. (1) Decreto 55/2025 / Decreto 72/2026 art. 2.5 fixes NO non-EU price: 'La universidad establecerá, mediante resolución rectoral debidamente motivada, los precios a abonar por la matrícula en estudios de grado y máster por el alumnado extranjero mayor de dieciocho años que no tenga la condición de residente', excluding EU nationals and those under the régimen comunitario, with the resolution capped at the previous year's rates. (2) The universities of the Sistema Universitario de Galicia agreed the price jointly at '25 % del coste de referencia para cada uno de los epígrafes de la tarifa primera', which in practice lands at EXACTLY 125% of the ordinary per-credit price: UDC's resolution sets 17,41 EUR/crédito for epígrafe A and 12,31 EUR/crédito for epígrafe B against ordinary 13,93 and 9,85 — i.e. a flat +25% surcharge. Universidade de Vigo states the same rule in plain terms: non-resident non-EU students over 18 pay academic fees 'increased by 25%'. (3) THE EXEMPTION: the resolution carries an ANEXO of 'países con índice de desarrollo humano (IDH) medio y bajo' whose nationals pay the ORDINARY decree prices. MOROCCO IS ON THAT LIST. TUNISIA IS NOT (nor is any other Maghreb state except Morocco). Tunisia is classed High HDI, so this candidate pays the +25% rate. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: the 17,41 / 12,31 figures and the country annex are read from UDC's resolution for 2022/23, the most recent full text obtainable — the 2025/26 resolution (30 June 2025) and the 2026/27 one (2 July 2026) exist and are announced by UDC but their texts sit behind sede.udc.gal document links that were not retrievable. The ordinary rates have been frozen at 13,93 / 9,85 across 2022/23–2026/27 and both decrees cap the resolution at the prior year's level, so the figures are almost certainly unchanged — but a human should open the current resolution to confirm, and to confirm Tunisia's continued absence from the annex.

notes: COST ARITHMETIC. Galicia bands master prices by EPÍGRAFE (subject area), not by experimentality, and first-enrolment price is IDENTICAL for habilitante and non-habilitante masters — only repeat enrolments diverge. Decreto 55/2025 (2025/26), TARIFA PRIMERA: Epígrafe A (engineering, architecture, health) 13,93 EUR/crédito 1ª matrícula; Epígrafe B (humanities, social sciences, LAW) 9,85 EUR/crédito 1ª matrícula. For 'otras enseñanzas de máster oficiales' (non-habilitante, which this is) the 2ª y sucesivas rate jumps steeply: 38,54 (A) / 26,68 (B). Decreto 72/2026 keeps 13,93 / 9,85 for 2026/27 — the rates are frozen. THIS IS A LAW MASTER, so EPÍGRAFE B applies. TWO FIGURES: (a) ordinary/EU rate 9,85 EUR/ECTS x 60 ECTS = 591,00 EUR; (b) as a Tunisian non-resident, +25% = 12,31 EUR/ECTS x 60 ECTS = 738,60 EUR. The 738,60 is recorded in tuition_total_eur because it is what this candidate would pay; the 591,00 is kept here so the 147,60 EUR surcharge is traceable. additional_fees_eur = 22,31 (apertura) + 4,79 (tarjeta) + 1,75 (apoyo matrícula online) = 28,85. ADMINISTRATIVE FEES (tarifa tercera, secretaría): apertura de expediente académico 22,31 EUR (new students only); expedición del título de máster oficial 123,10 EUR at the end; tarjeta de identidad universitaria 4,79 EUR; apoyo a la matrícula en línea 1,75 EUR; seguro escolar 1,12 EUR for under-28s only. GALICIA'S 99% BONIFICACIÓN (art. 13 of Decreto 72/2026) DOES NOT HELP HERE: it requires enrolling in at least 60 credits in first enrolment in 2026/27 AND expressly excludes anyone who already holds a university degree ('grado, licenciatura, diplomatura...'), which disqualifies every master's entrant by definition. Do not budget for it. RATE-YEAR CAVEAT: Galicia publishes its decree each late June/early July for the coming course; September 2027 falls under a decree not yet written.

entry_requirements: Applicants must meet AT LEAST ONE of three routes: (1) a degree in Business, Marketing, Market Research, Finance or Economics with a minimum of 18 ECTS in quantitative techniques and 3 ECTS in programming and algorithms; (2) a degree in ENGINEERING, Statistics or Mathematics — but with complementary courses in Marketing and Business Administration required; (3) professionals with a minimum of two years of demonstrable experience in related areas.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. 'Ingeniería' is named as one of the three qualifying access routes. But it is the route that carries a bridging obligation (see complementary_credits_required), unlike the business/economics route.
complementary_credits_required: 0 in RUCT — BUT THE RUCT ZERO IS MISLEADING HERE, AND THIS IS EXACTLY THE CASE THE BRIEF WARNS ABOUT. The register records ects_complementos_formativos = 0, meaning the TITLE carries no compulsory bridging credits. At APPLICANT level VIU imposes them by background, and an engineering entrant is precisely the profile that triggers them: a candidate entering via the Engineering/Statistics/Mathematics route 'must complete complementary courses in Marketing and Business Administration'. VIU publishes a menu of four 6-ECTS complementos — Fundamentos del Marketing (6 ECTS), Fundamentos de Administración y Dirección de Empresas (6 ECTS), Métodos cuantitativos (6 ECTS), Bases de datos, algoritmos y programación (6 ECTS). A software engineer would be assigned the two business ones (12 ECTS) and exempted from the two quantitative/programming ones. COST CONSEQUENCE: 12 extra ECTS on top of the 60, almost certainly charged at the same per-credit rate, i.e. roughly a 20% increase in both cost and workload. The exact assignment must be confirmed with VIU admissions.
credit_recognition_available: PARTIALLY ANSWERED, AND IN A USEFUL DIRECTION. VIU does not publish a reconocimiento de créditos rule for a 300-ECTS entrant. However, the complementos menu itself functions as a de facto recognition test: 'Métodos cuantitativos' and 'Bases de datos, algoritmos y programación' are the complementos a non-technical applicant would take, and a 300-ECTS Software Engineering graduate should be exempt from both on prior study.
